title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-30
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with a muffled yet airy mix showcases a strong Carousel run highlighted by Dark Star, Born Cross‑Eyed > Spanish Jam and a sparkling Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The recording is an SBD that sounds a bit distant and uneven, giving the 1968 Carousel show an atmospheric but sometimes muddy feel. Musically the night shines with a soaring Dark Star, a gorgeous Born Cross‑Eyed → Spanish Jam suite and bright moments from Morning Dew and China Cat → Eleven, though The Other One and some of Garcia’s leads are viewed as uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple reviewers praise key performances while noting consistent recording muffiness; weighted average of show (≈3.8) and recording quality (≈3.0) yields a solid mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muffled, distant sound with an airy ambience; mixing is uneven and at times rough, but still listenable for a 1968 SBD.

poor_songs: Short Dark Star (as noted by some reviewers)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The Carousel set flows well, featuring strong segues into the Spanish jam and a bright early‑'68 energy; despite some flat moments the overall pacing keeps momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia earns praise for a terrific Morning Dew solo and an inspired Dark Star, but other reviewers call his playing hit‑or‑miss and note a sloppy Other One.
